contribution: Methods for empirical analysis of imperfectly competitive markets (modern empirical industrial organization): estimating demand and supply for differentiated products, and dynamic models of firm entry, exit and investment
rationale: This is a low-confidence guess. The BLP demand-estimation framework and the Pakes-led dynamic oligopoly and production-function work are widely used in merger analysis, antitrust and policy evaluation, and empirical IO has never won a Nobel. Recent prizes went to growth (2025), institutions (2024), labor and gender (2023), banking (2022) and causal inference (2021), so a methods-driven IO prize fits the rotation of fields.
